name: elsegundo.xyz atlas
description: Every place, court, event, business, quiet place, ping zone, page, bot and tool elsegundo.xyz knows how to place, in one file. The 25-mile El Segundo layer first, then wider.
licenseNote: Records carry their own license when it differs; OpenStreetMap-derived records are ODbL-1.0 with attribution.
notOfficial: Not an official City of El Segundo page.

center.name: El Segundo City Hall, 350 Main Street
center.method: Published LA County Services Locator facility point; not a surveyed entrance.

layers.name: Places and courts
layers.description: Hand-researched El Segundo parks, courts, pools, civic buildings, landmarks, streets, districts and transit stops, each with the public pages it was read from.
layers.notes: From content/places/curated.json (checked 2026-10-29). Only 11 of 48 places carry coordinates; the rest have no location rather than an estimated one. Source label is fact for .gov pages and the city recreation department domains, listing for everything else. content/places/verified.json (facts businesses confirmed themselves) is empty today, so it adds nothing. Coordinates are as recorded in the curated file; they are not surveyed entrances.

layers.name: Here cards
layers.description: In-the-moment guide cards: a sit-down spot, a walk, a ride, each anchored to a published point with a one-line glance.
layers.notes: From public/here/index.json spots[] (7 live). Only spots with status live are layered; planned[] is empty today. A spot with tag do:sit is a quiet-place, the beach bike path and the dog walk are routes (their anchor is a representative point, marked block precision), the rest are places (their ids carry a here- prefix so they never collide with the curated place of the same name). Each spot links to its curated place when the card names one.

layers.name: Civic atlas pilot
layers.description: A hand-picked pilot of civic services within 25 miles of El Segundo City Hall: libraries, community centers, transit, workforce and help lines, each with the official page and quote it came from.
layers.notes: From public/atlas/data.json (checked 2026-10-30). A pilot, not a complete inventory: source-verified means identity and location were checked, not live hours. All 18 records are verified; 3 pending records the file excludes stay out. Coordinates are LA County facility points or Census address-range matches (marked address precision); records with no verified pin have no location.

layers.name: El Segundo businesses (OpenStreetMap)
layers.description: Businesses mapped in OpenStreetMap with an El Segundo address inside the city box, from a dated snapshot.
layers.notes: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/). 83 records from content/places/osm.json, snapshot 2026-10-24. These are dated map records, not verified businesses: current operation, hours and ownership are not checked. The wider 25-mile directory stays a reference dataset at the data URL. Names, types and positions come from OpenStreetMap; no phone numbers or opening hours are copied.

layers.name: Region maps and ping zones
layers.description: The editorial "Regions of" neighborhood maps for El Segundo and its neighbors, and the zones of the El Segundo community ping.
layers.notes: Areas: the 14 /maps/{slug}/ pages that exist today, dated by their lastmod in sitemap.xml; they are editorial maps, not legal boundaries, and carry no coordinates. Hermosa Beach, Manhattan Beach, Redondo Beach and Torrance have map images but no page yet, so they are not layered. Ping zones: from content/ping/rules.json zones[] (positions are on a 1600x1900 image, not geography); the checked date is the last git commit date of that file because the file carries no date. Only four zones get a location, each a representative curated place, never a zone centroid, marked neighborhood precision. Read the live game at the data URL (/board, /week and /rules sit beside it).

layers.name: Pickleball venues
layers.description: Places to play pickleball in the South Bay, from the elsegundo.xyz venue register, with access, courts and fees.
layers.notes: Coordinates are the venue register coordinates, each cited to the venue page. Courts page has no per-venue anchors, so records link to the venue list on /pickleball/.

layers.name: Pickleball play and pages
layers.description: Leagues, clinics, drop-ins, tournaments, the results-based player directory, pickleball pages and the live court feed.
layers.notes: Zero player records: the directory has zero verified claims, so no person is mapped. The directory is one league record. Static items without a venue id carry no location.

layers.name: Bots, MCP tools and feeds
layers.description: What a bot can read or do on elsegundo.xyz: the bot map intents, the MCP tools and the machine-readable feeds.
layers.notes: MCP tool records come from the committed catalog.json, so they follow the catalog regeneration. Feed records cite the feed itself and its own date field. No location: tools and feeds are not places.

layers.name: Events
layers.description: Upcoming events around El Segundo and the South Bay from the current events edition, each with its organizer source.
layers.notes: Events drop off after they end, so counts change with each edition. An event gets a location only when its venue text names a curated place with cited coordinates; that point is the place, not the event.

layers.name: University of El Segundo
layers.description: The 24 short AI lessons and the section pages of the University of El Segundo learning project.
layers.notes: Community learning content with no accreditation claimed. The voting section is not mapped (no voting advice in the atlas). No location: lessons and pages are not places.

layers.name: Industry Next
layers.description: Industry Next, Michael Hoydich's independent AI and creative studio: the studio page, its published formats and proposed offers.
layers.notes: Proposed offers are marked planned: they are proposals, not live engagements. Contact details and prices are not mapped.

layers.name: Datasets and sister towns
layers.description: The datasets elsegundo.xyz publishes (business directory, jobs, knowledge tree, census portrait, AI thesis atlas, quick answers) and the sister-town pages beyond the 25 miles.
layers.notes: The 29,122 OpenStreetMap business rows are referenced by one dataset record, not inlined; they stay in directory-lite.json under ODbL-1.0. Sister-town areas carry no location.

layers.name: Architecture
layers.description: Notable buildings and structures in El Segundo and across the South Bay and Los Angeles, each with the dated public sources behind its claims.
layers.notes: From public/architecture/buildings.json (checked 2026-11-03). Coordinates are as recorded in the catalog: Wikipedia infobox or OpenStreetMap points are precise, rows marked "estimate" are neighborhood-level only. Source label comes from the claim label in the catalog (fact for official pages, reported for press and encyclopedias). Buildings that are closed or dismantled carry status historical. Buildings farther than 25 miles from the site center carry the tag wider.

layers.name: Business directory
layers.description: El Segundo businesses whose basics were read from the business's own page, with the page and the date it was checked.
layers.notes: From public/directory/businesses.json (checked 2026-11-08). Phone numbers are left out. Coordinates are US Census geocoder points or OpenStreetMap positions as recorded in the file; records without a recorded coordinate source have no location (EZPZ is not geocoded yet). Records whose OpenStreetMap-derived position is used carry ODbL-1.0 with attribution. The file marks every record "checked", which is not an atlas status, so no status is set. Records whose status says closed or removed are skipped (none today).

layers.name: Breweries and taprooms
layers.description: Breweries, brewpubs and taprooms within 25 miles of El Segundo, each with the brewery's own pages and the date they were checked.
layers.notes: From public/breweries/breweries.json (checked 2026-11-03). Every brewery lists public source URLs (its own site, the LA County Brewers Guild, local press); sources are labelled listing for the brewery's own pages and the brewers guild, fact for .gov pages and reported otherwise. Coordinates come from the guide: Census geocoder points get precision address, ZIP-centroid points get neighborhood. Hours are not copied into the atlas; they live on each brewery page. Breweries beyond 25 miles of the site center carry the tag wider.
